1: // Asteroid Escape – enhanced graphics targeting <canvas id="game">
2: 
3: (() => {
4:   const canvas = document.getElementById('game');
5:   // Audio setup
6:   const audioCtx = new (window.AudioContext || window.webkitAudioContext)();
7:   function playSound(freq, duration) {
8:     const osc = audioCtx.createOscillator();
9:     const gain = audioCtx.createGain();
10:     osc.frequency.value = freq;
11:     osc.type = 'sine';
12:     osc.connect(gain);
13:     gain.connect(audioCtx.destination);
14:     osc.start();
15:     osc.stop(audioCtx.currentTime + duration);
16:   }
17:   const ctx = canvas.getContext('2d');
18:   const W = (canvas.width = 800);
19:   const H = (canvas.height = 400);
20: 
21:   // Game state
22:   let score = 0;
23:   let fuel = 100; // percent
24:   let gameOver = false;
25:   const ship = { x: 80, y: H / 2, w: 30, h: 20, speedY: 0 };
26:   const asteroids = [];
27:   const stars = [];
28:   // Initialize starfield
29:   for (let i = 0; i < 100; i++) {
30:     stars.push({
31:       x: Math.random() * W,
32:       y: Math.random() * H,
33:       speed: 0.5 + Math.random() * 1.0,
34:       alpha: 0.5 + Math.random() * 0.5,
35:     });
36:   }
37:   const fuels = [];
38: 
39:   // Input handling
40:   const keys = {};
41:   addEventListener('keydown', e => {
42:     // Unlock audio on first interaction
43:     if (audioCtx.state === 'suspended') audioCtx.resume();
44:     keys[e.key] = true;
45:     if (e.key === 'ArrowUp') playSound(300, 0.05);
46:   });
47:   addEventListener('keyup', e => (keys[e.key] = false));
48: 
49:   function spawnAsteroid() {
50:   // Each asteroid gets a random rotation and speed
51:   const rotation = Math.random() * Math.PI * 2;
52:   const rotSpeed = (Math.random() - 0.5) * 0.02; // radians per frame
53:   const size = 20 + Math.random() * 30;
54:   asteroids.push({ x: W + size, y: Math.random() * (H - size), r: size, vx: -3 - Math.random() * 2, angle: rotation, rotSpeed });
55: }
56:     const size = 20 + Math.random() * 30;
57:     asteroids.push({ x: W + size, y: Math.random() * (H - size), r: size, vx: -3 - Math.random() * 2 });
58:   }
59:   function spawnFuel() {
60:     const r = 10;
61:     fuels.push({ x: W + r, y: Math.random() * (H - r), r, vx: -3 });
62:   }
63: 
64:   // Simple collision (circle–rectangle for ship)
65:   function rectCircleCollide(rect, cx, cy, cr) {
66:     const dx = Math.max(rect.x, Math.min(cx, rect.x + rect.w));
67:     const dy = Math.max(rect.y, Math.min(cy, rect.y + rect.h));
68:     const dist = Math.hypot(dx - cx, dy - cy);
69:     return dist < cr;
70:   }
71: 
72:   function update() {
73:     if (gameOver) return;
74:     // Ship vertical control
75:     if (keys['ArrowUp']) ship.speedY = -4;
76:     else if (keys['ArrowDown']) ship.speedY = 4;
77:     else ship.speedY = 0;
78:     ship.y = Math.max(0, Math.min(H - ship.h, ship.y + ship.speedY));
79: 
80:     // Move asteroids & fuels
81:     asteroids.forEach(a => (a.x += a.vx));
82:     fuels.forEach(f => (f.x += f.vx));
83:     // Move stars for scrolling background
84:     stars.forEach(s => {
85:       s.x -= s.speed;
86:       if (s.x < 0) {
87:         s.x = W;
88:         s.y = Math.random() * H;
89:         s.speed = 0.5 + Math.random() * 1.0;
90:         s.alpha = 0.5 + Math.random() * 0.5;
91:       }
92:     });
93:     // Remove off‑screen objects
94:     while (asteroids.length && asteroids[0].x + asteroids[0].r < 0) asteroids.shift();
95:     while (fuels.length && fuels[0].x + fuels[0].r < 0) fuels.shift();
96: 
97:     // Collision detection
98:     for (let i = asteroids.length - 1; i >= 0; i--) {
99:       const a = asteroids[i];
100:       if (rectCircleCollide(ship, a.x, a.y, a.r)) {
101:           gameOver = true;
102:           playSound(150, 0.4); // collision sound
103:           break;
104:         }
105:     }
106:     for (let i = fuels.length - 1; i >= 0; i--) {
107:       const f = fuels[i];
108: if (rectCircleCollide(ship, f.x, f.y, f.r)) {
109:           fuel = Math.min(100, fuel + 20);
110:           score += 10;
111:           fuels.splice(i, 1);
112:           playSound(600, 0.1); // fuel collect sound
113:         }
114:     }
115: 
116:     // Consume fuel over time
117:     fuel -= 0.05;
118:     if (fuel <= 0) gameOver = true;
119:     score += 0.1;
120:   }
121: 
122:   function drawBackground() {
123:     // Fill black background
124:     ctx.fillStyle = '#000';
125:     ctx.fillRect(0, 0, W, H);
126:     // Draw starfield
127:     ctx.fillStyle = '#fff';
128:     stars.forEach(s => {
129:       ctx.globalAlpha = s.alpha;
130:       ctx.fillRect(s.x, s.y, 2, 2);
131:     });
132:     ctx.globalAlpha = 1;
133:   }
134: 
135: function draw() {
136:     // Draw background first
137:     drawBackground();
138:     // Ship – gradient triangle with thrust
139:     const shipGradient = ctx.createLinearGradient(ship.x, ship.y, ship.x + ship.w, ship.y + ship.h);
140:     shipGradient.addColorStop(0, '#0f0');
141:     shipGradient.addColorStop(1, '#060');
142:     ctx.fillStyle = shipGradient;
143:     ctx.beginPath();
144:     ctx.moveTo(ship.x, ship.y);
145:     ctx.lineTo(ship.x, ship.y + ship.h);
146:     ctx.lineTo(ship.x + ship.w, ship.y + ship.h / 2);
147:     ctx.closePath();
148:     ctx.fill();
149:     // Thrust flame when moving up
150:     if (keys['ArrowUp']) {
151:       ctx.fillStyle = 'orange';
152:       ctx.beginPath();
153:       ctx.moveTo(ship.x, ship.y + ship.h / 2);
154:       ctx.lineTo(ship.x - 10, ship.y + ship.h / 2 - 5);
155:       ctx.lineTo(ship.x - 10, ship.y + ship.h / 2 + 5);
156:       ctx.closePath();
157:       ctx.fill();
158:     }
159:     // Asteroids – radial gradient
160: asteroids.forEach(a => {
161:         // Update rotation
162:         a.angle += a.rotSpeed;
163:         // Draw rotated asteroid with gradient
164:         ctx.save();
165:         ctx.translate(a.x, a.y);
166:         ctx.rotate(a.angle);
167:         const grad = ctx.createRadialGradient(0, 0, a.r * 0.3, 0, 0, a.r);
168:         grad.addColorStop(0, '#777');
169:         grad.addColorStop(1, '#222');
170:         ctx.fillStyle = grad;
171:         ctx.beginPath();
172:         ctx.arc(0, 0, a.r, 0, 2 * Math.PI);
173:         ctx.fill();
174:         ctx.restore();
175:       });
176:     // Fuel cells – glowing
177:     fuels.forEach(f => {
178:       ctx.fillStyle = '#ff0';
179:       ctx.beginPath();
180:       ctx.arc(f.x, f.y, f.r, 0, 2 * Math.PI);
181:       ctx.fill();
182:       // subtle outer glow
183:       ctx.strokeStyle = 'rgba(255,255,0,0.5)';
184:       ctx.lineWidth = 2;
185:       ctx.stroke();
186:     });
187:     // HUD – semi‑transparent background
188:     ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(255,255,255,0.7)';
189:     ctx.fillRect(0, 0, 120, 60);
190:     ctx.fillStyle = '#000';
191:     ctx.font = '16px sans-serif';
192:     ctx.fillText(`Score: ${Math.floor(score)}`, 10, 20);
193:     ctx.fillText(`Fuel: ${Math.floor(fuel)}%`, 10, 40);
194:     if (gameOver) {
195:       ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(0,0,0,0.5)';
196:       ctx.fillRect(0, 0, W, H);
197:       ctx.fillStyle = '#fff';
198:       ctx.textAlign = 'center';
199:       ctx.font = '48px sans-serif';
200:       ctx.fillText('Game Over', W / 2, H / 2);
201:     }
202:   }
203: 
204:   function loop() {
205:     update();
206:     draw();
207:     if (!gameOver) requestAnimationFrame(loop);
208:   }
209: 
210:   // Spawn timers
211:   setInterval(spawnAsteroid, 1500);
212:   setInterval(spawnFuel, 4000);
213: 
214:   // Start
215:   loop();
216: })();
